customerId.description: The 10-digit Google Ads account id to query, e.g. 1234567890 (dashes allowed). Under a manager account this is the client account, not the manager.

loginCustomerId.description: Manager (MCC) account id, sent as the login-customer-id header. Required when the account is accessed through a manager account.

pageToken.description: nextPageToken from a previous response, to fetch the next 10000 rows.

query.description: GAQL query, e.g. SELECT campaign.name, metrics.cost_micros FROM campaign WHERE segments.date DURING LAST_7_DAYS.
